verdict.rationale: Formant is a robot fleet operations platform, so asking whether the same code can target simulation and real hardware is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions simulation or sim-to-real code portability. Items such as Docker/ROS agent installation, editing ROS_MASTER_URI, and the Agent SDK are general connectivity building blocks, not a documented simulation capability.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can run the same robot code against simulation and the real robot without a rewrite
